title: Harbor Planning Integration Master Roadmap
goal: Make Planning the immutable definition and revision truth for projects and roadmaps, then hand one approved revision to /abc so Temporal Light can execute it and Agent can show every mutable runtime fact for 12-24 hour shifts.
user_workflow: The user and an AI define project intent, slices, dependencies, gate requirements, verification and done conditions as a Planning draft.
Planning validates the complete definition, assigns a monotonically increasing revision and computes the canonical content hash.
Planning edits only definitions and revisions; it never creates, mutates or renders execution state.
Open in Agent resolves exactly one approved revision, switches to Agent and prepares the canonical /abc command without submitting it or starting a run.
The user submits /abc from Agent. /abc remains the sole intelligent entrypoint and selects the required secondary skills and models at runtime.
/abc authorizes the run, pins the exact roadmap revision and hash, and emits one immutable execution manifest.
Temporal Light executes the manifest deterministically through Activities while Odysseus retains claim, fencing, effect, evidence and live-go authority.
Agent displays run state, Activities, history, attempts, retries, timers, heartbeats, claims, leases, gates, commands and evidence.
A structural change never mutates the pinned revision; Agent proposes a new Planning draft and the current run either finishes against the old revision or stops with requires_plan_revision.
Definition notifications open Planning. Execution failures, stale heartbeats, runtime gate waits and run completion open Agent.

sub_roadmaps.role: Definition-only MCP contract for validated reads, drafts, revisions, context packs and Agent handoff creation. Legacy runtime progress writes are deprecated.
Visual and interaction reference only. Its Planning/runtime semantics are explicitly superseded by HPIM-PDE and HPIM-TLR.
Authoritative Planning-screen definition, revision, graph and editor track. It contains no execution state or controls.
Odysseus authority, claim, fencing, effect, evidence and live-go boundary consumed by Temporal Activities.
Temporal Light execution track shown exclusively in Agent. It consumes an immutable Planning revision and never writes runtime state back into Planning.
Canonical lifecycle for derived Raptor Memory entries and provenance without raw private content.
Safe notification boundary; Harbor Planning uses sparse structural events only.
Review and undo surfaces for deletes, gates, uncertain writes and operator decisions.

screen_ownership_boundary.decision: The screen boundary is normative. Any field, endpoint or control not assigned below is rejected until this master roadmap is deliberately revised.
planning_screen_owns: roadmap revisions, hashes and definition lifecycle
gate requirements, never live gate decisions
allowed paths, verification commands and done contracts
draft validation, diff, apply proposal, conflict resolution and undo
agent_screen_owns: run creation through authenticated /abc submission and current run state
Temporal workflow ids and run ids
Activities, workflow history, attempts, retries and timers
heartbeats, stale detection, claims, leases and fencing
evidence receipts, commits, provider stages and execution completion
secondary skill and model selections made by /abc
planning_forbidden: attempts, retries, timers or history events
heartbeats, claims, leases, workers or fencing tokens
Signals, Updates, commands or runtime gate decisions
evidence receipts, commits, provider stages or execution controls
concrete runtime skill or model choices
agent_forbidden: silent mutation of a pinned Planning revision
starting a run without authenticated /abc authorization
treating runtime history as a Planning definition revision
granting commit, push, merge, deploy or provider authority outside Odysseus gates

canonical_project_structure.principle: Versioned JSON definitions are the Planning source of truth. Markdown is a rendered view or handoff only. Runtime state is stored outside the Planning root and is joined only by the Agent read model.
notes: Roadmap files may be stored under docs/plans while the service is repo-only, but the logical project layout should already appear in metadata.
Project, roadmap, gate, todo and event IDs must be stable enough for UI deep links and MCP context packs.
Delete operations must create undo metadata before removing or hiding the target.
Gate-definition files describe requirements and targets only; go/no-go decisions are runtime gate instances owned by Agent/Odysseus.
Todo objects in Planning describe intended work. Their queued, running, blocked and done instances are runtime records and are not written back into Planning.

notification_policy.principle: Notifications route by truth plane: definition changes open Planning; execution events open Agent. Neither screen mirrors the other screen's mutable state.
ui_behavior: Notifications appear in the Harbor header bell, not as modal interruptions.
A definition notification opens Planning and resolves an exact project, roadmap and revision reference.
An execution notification opens Agent and resolves an exact owner, workflow and run reference.
Planning notifications never carry workflow state; Agent notifications never claim that a Planning definition changed.
Routine MCP calls must not create visible notifications.

graph_rules: Every visible line is an edge to a Roadmap or Gate node.
Node and edge colors encode definition kind or validation state only; they never encode a run state, attempt state or runtime gate decision.
Roadmap rectangles show only the roadmap designation while collapsed.
Expanded roadmap rectangles show a short full-roadmap summary.
Gate nodes show declared requirements and their target slices, never live go/no-go decisions.
Hovering a gate dims unrelated nodes and highlights the affected roadmaps and direct gate edges.
Planning renders definition_completeness_percent only when it is computed from required definition fields; it renders no execution progress or completion overlay.

visible_in_frontpage_v2: Planning workspace with Projects, Overview and Roadmaps windows.
Roadmap list and graph selection highlight each other.
Roadmap selection opens a Document Viewer-style roadmap document.
Roadmap document has a readable mode with summary, tasks and gates plus a Data mode for JSON.
Spark buttons can send the full roadmap or a roadmap section to the Agent composer as a pinned context bubble.
Spark switches the active workspace to Agent and focuses the composer.
prototype_boundaries: The V2 prototype is a visual interaction reference only; its mixed Planning/runtime ownership is not portable to V3.
Roadmap Viewer content is derived from static demo graph data, not from real project JSON files.
Editable fields are UI-only and do not persist through Planning MCP yet.
Spark currently creates frontend context bubbles only; it does not yet request a service-backed context pack.
Roadmap document JSON is a rendered draft view, not yet validated or written back as planning truth.
Selection-to-document behavior is implemented for visible roadmap demo nodes only.
No Playwright regression flow exists yet for list selection, graph selection, viewer opening or Spark handoff.
Any V2 field representing progress, target run state, execution status, active worker, gate decision or evidence belongs exclusively to the Agent execution projection.

open_integration_gaps.summary: Replace static V2 roadmap demo data with service-backed project and roadmap JSON payloads.
Persist Roadmap Document Viewer edits through validated Planning MCP draft or patch flow.
Turn Spark from frontend context bubble creation into a service-backed context-pack handoff.
Let sparse Planning notifications open Overview, highlight the changed roadmap and optionally open its document viewer.
Add Playwright coverage for roadmap selection, viewer opening, edit affordances and Spark handoff.

mcp_contract_requirements: Planning MCP reads and writes definition objects only; runtime progress, checkpoints, heartbeats, claims, evidence and gate decisions are rejected.
Roadmap creation and revision writes validate the complete JSON schema, dependency DAG and runtime-field denylist before persistence.
planning_mark_status is deprecated and must not appear in the V2 definition tool surface.
The Agent handoff pins project_id, roadmap_id, revision and content_hash and always returns launch_authorized=false.
Only an authenticated /abc submission in Agent may convert that handoff into an execution manifest and start request.
Definition creation, revision, conflict and deletion events may emit sparse Planning notifications.
Deletion returns undo metadata and never becomes irreversible without an operator-visible recovery path.
Context packs may include Raptor Memory summaries and provenance, but not raw private content.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Hand the five V2 Planning integration/browser slices to the UI owner and approve their interaction sequence without changing backend contract ownership.
gate_queue.safe_preparation_done: HPIM-1 storage and HPIM-4 notification-candidate contracts are repository-ready. PMCP-5b, PMCP-5c, PMCP-5d and PMCP-6b remain independently completable backend contracts and do not pre-complete these UI slices.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: A backend runner could edit active V2 UI hotfiles, claim UI done from route tests alone or add Playwright coverage before the intended interactions exist.

integration_gate_references.decision: Approve the definition-only Planning information architecture and browser acceptance packet.
Authorize one named real-roadmap apply and exact restoration smoke.
Approve the Agent operational information architecture and controls before runtime UI implementation.
Authorize the bounded 12-hour local wall-clock soak after time-skipping and recovery acceptance pass.
Authorize a production-grade Temporal service and monitored canary; local Temporal Light remains the default until then.

non_goals: No notification for every Planning MCP tool call.
No raw private content in roadmap memory entries, notifications, audit logs or context packs.
No Markdown source of truth for planning state.
No irreversible delete without undo metadata.
No automatic completion of roadmap work without evidence refs.
No run state, runtime gate decision, heartbeat, Activity, history, claim, evidence or execution control in Planning.
No separate Temporal dashboard; Agent is the only operator surface for execution.
No direct run start from Planning and no run start that bypasses authenticated /abc authorization.
No custom scheduler alongside Temporal Light and no transfer of Odysseus claim, fencing, effect or live-go authority to Temporal.
verification: Future PDE-07: Playwright definition-only Planning acceptance
Future TLR-09: Temporal time-skipping, replay, restart, heartbeat and idempotency acceptance
Future HPIM-14: cross-screen browser acceptance packet

shared_router_handoff_required.safe_default: Use this HPIM roadmap as the immediate master and do not mutate a deferred router without a fresh claim.
